**Group:** Ciliates  ·  **Optics:** high-mag, low-mag

## Defining characteristics

Single-celled protists covered wholly or partly in cilia used for swimming and feeding, with no external lorica (tintinnid). Cells are often ovoid or conical with bands or rows of cilia, and may contain ingested prey or retained chloroplasts. Use this class for ciliates that lack a lorica and cannot be placed into another label. Key features: cilia, a single motile cell, no lorica.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **tiarina** | Label Tiarina for the distinctive fusiform (spindle) predatory ciliate; use the generic Ciliate class when the ciliate can't be identified further. |
| **tintinnid** | Tintinnids sit inside an external lorica (shell); the generic Ciliate class is for naked ciliates without one. |
